title: Uruguayan Italian Empanadas
description: Delicious Italian-Style Empanadas filled with savory Uruguayan flavors.

ingredients.name: Empanada filling (Uruguayan cheese & Aromatic onion mix)

instructions: Combine flour, salt, and water to make the empanada dough.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces, and roll each one into a thin circle.
In a bowl, mix Uruguayan cheese, Aromatic onion, and Score of garlic.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of filling onto one half of each dough circle.
Fold the other half of dough over the filling, and press edges to seal.
Brush tops of empanadas with Fat (lard or butter).
Bake empanadas for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
